tldr: Sharp honest simultaneous CATE bands below and at the nuisance elbow. For fixed \(\alpha,\beta\in(0,1]\), the strict-region frontier is \(\{\sqrt{\log(en)}/n\}^{(1+d/(2\gamma)+d/(2S))^{-1}}\) when \(S<d\gamma/(2\gamma+d)\); on the separately defined nonempty boundary class, the frontier is \(\{\log(en)/n\}^{\gamma/(2\gamma+d)}\). Total close-pair local-polynomial bands attain both rates using deterministic H\"older bias allowances, simultaneous Hoeffding and canonical concentration, and spectral fallback. Fixed-sample many-location mixtures under exactly uniform covariates give the matching converses.
gap: Published minimax CATE theory determines pointwise estimation rates and explicitly leaves \(L_\infty\) loss and inference open. Published uniform CATE bands instead use parametric, sparse linear, or randomized-experiment structure and do not determine an honest rough-nuisance minimax width.
fill: The project couples a total pair-difference local-polynomial band with deterministic bias and spectral allowances to a fixed-sample spatial mixture converse whose singleton cancellation and cross-cell orthogonality are exact under uniform covariates.
